players.product: camera modules for autonomous vehicles / robotaxis

quarterly_data.signal: Partner Applied Intuition (US autonomous driving software company; strategic partnership signed in March): LG Innotek has started operating autonomous-driving sensing data collection vehicles on Korean roads, beginning in the Seoul, Incheon and Gyeonggi area, and plans to run a fleet of about 20 vehicles in Korea by 2028, including data collection vehicles and autonomous driving software development vehicles. The vehicles carry camera, radar and LiDAR sensors; the data is used to advance the company's sensor fusion technology and sensor performance. Applied Intuition's data collection vehicles fitted with LG Innotek sensing modules are also to run in the US, Europe and Japan. The company plans to use its combined camera / radar / LiDAR sensing solution to push for new customer orders in North America and Europe; CTO Min John: LG Innotek will move quickly to take the physical AI sensing market, including autonomous driving.
quarterly_data.figure: fleet of about 20 vehicles in Korea by 2028
